messages.author: SATYAJIT KHATUA
messages.body:
Dear Users,
I am facing a strange kind of issue that says "*PatchingError:
.patches/AmberTools19_Unapplied_Patches/update.11 failed to apply. No
changes made from this patch*" for AmberTools 19/update.11 patch. I haven't
faced this kind of problem before and don't know how to resolve it. I also
searched for the related issues and tried all the solutions reported, with
all ending in failure. Running the command "*patch -p0 -N --dry-run <
.patches/AmberTools19_Unapplied_Patches/update.11*" shows the following
message:
*(Stripping trailing CRs from patch; use --binary to disable.)checking file
AmberTools/src/rism/amber_rism_interface.F90Hunk #1 succeeded at 634
(offset -3 lines).Hunk #2 succeeded at 2659 (offset -9 lines).Hunk #3
succeeded at 2669 (offset -9 lines).Hunk #4 succeeded at 2679 (offset -7
lines).Hunk #5 FAILED at 2738.Hunk #6 FAILED at 2745.Hunk #7 FAILED at
2870.Hunk #8 FAILED at 2878.Hunk #9 FAILED at 2952.Hunk #10 FAILED at
2959.Hunk #11 FAILED at 3029.Hunk #12 FAILED at 3036.Hunk #13 FAILED at
3161.Hunk #14 FAILED at 3178.Hunk #15 FAILED at 3302.Hunk #16 FAILED at
3315.Hunk #17 FAILED at 3336.Hunk #18 FAILED at 3358.Hunk #19 FAILED at
3365.15 out of 19 hunks FAILED(Stripping trailing CRs from patch; use
--binary to disable.)checking file AmberTools/src/rism/depend(Stripping
trailing CRs from patch; use --binary to disable.)checking file
AmberTools/src/rism/rism3d_c.F90Hunk #1 succeeded at 514 (offset -5
lines).(Stripping trailing CRs from patch; use --binary to
disable.)checking file AmberTools/src/rism/rism3d_potential_c.F90(Stripping
trailing CRs from patch; use --binary to disable.)checking file
AmberTools/src/rism/rism3d_tree_cp.F90(Stripping trailing CRs from patch;
use --binary to disable.)checking file AmberTools/src/rism/rism_io.F90*
Does anyone have any idea about this kind of error? Please help me to
resolve it.
With regards,
Satyajit Khatua,
Research Scholar,
Department of Chemistry,
IIT Kharagpur, Kharagpur-721302
